Answers of the RDS describe calls the backups collection makes, in the AWS CLI's JSON (it unmarshals into the
SDK output types by field name). Every file here is *-constructed: built by hand from the documented fields of
DescribeDBClusters, DescribeDBClusterSnapshots, DescribeDBInstances and DescribeDBSnapshots, not recorded (the
lab's session had expired when they were written). The cluster's name is the lab's; the values are not its.
